faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Health Society Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Health Society Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 85 vacancies for Staff Nurses (On contract basis under NHM).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Health Society Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Tiruchirappalli District Collector website: https://tiruchirappalli.nic.in/notice_category/announcements/) and send it to District Health Officer, District Health Office, Race Course Road, Jamal Mohamed College Near, T.V.S tolegate, Tiruchirappalli-620 020, by in person or by speed post, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (DGNM) or B.Sc. Nursing from the Institution recognised by the Indian Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. A voluntary consent letter (undertaking) for joining the post must be submitted.

faq.answer: Posts are entirely temporary (11 months). The posts will not be made permanent at any time. Filled on temporary contract basis under the National Health Mission as per G.O. No. 427.
